jobs.title: Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
The Strategy Manager supports strategic planning, business analysis, and cross-functional execution across key organizational priorities. This role partners with stakeholders across multiple departments to structure complex business questions, analyze data, identify trends, and translate insights into clear recommendations that support decision-making.  This individual will help structure ambiguous business questions, develop clear workplans, gather and synthesize inputs from cross-functional partners, and communicate recommendations through presentations, written updates, and verbal discussions. The Strategy Manager will work closely with leaders and business partners to drive work forward, support alignment, and ensure strategy deliverables are completed with accuracy, clarity, and pace. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver with strong communication skills, sound business judgment, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while driving work to completion.
What you'll do
- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to support strategy initiatives, business planning efforts, and key projects aligned to department and organizational priorities.

- Break down complex or ambiguous business questions into structured workplans, analyses, and recommendations.

- Analyze data, identify trends, and synthesize insights to support business decisions and strategic recommendations.

- Develop clear, professional presentations, memos, and written communications for a variety of audiences, including senior leaders and executive stakeholders.

- Gather inputs from teams such as Finance, Operations, Product, Commercial, Marketing, and other business functions to help inform recommendations.

- Facilitate working sessions, project discussions, and stakeholder updates to drive alignment and move work to completion.

- Support the development of business cases, scenario analysis, market assessments, and other strategic deliverables.

- Distinguish key insights from available data and clearly communicate what the analysis supports.

- Manage priorities, timelines, and deliverables to ensure work is completed accurately and efficiently.

- Build strong working relationships across departments and act as a trusted partner in helping teams solve business challenges.

What we expect of you
- Bachelor degree and 5 years of experience in strategy, business analysis, consulting, finance, operations, corporate planning, or a related business function OR

- 9 years of experience in strategy, business analysis, consulting, finance, operations, corporate planning, or a related business function

Preferred skills, experience, and qualities needed
- Demonstrated experience structuring complex problems, analyzing information, and developing clear business recommendations.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively and professionally across all levels of the organization, including senior and executive leadership.

- Proven ability to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders across multiple departments.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities, drive work to completion, and adapt to changing business needs.

- Demonstrated ability to take ownership of responsibilities, navigate ambiguity, and work independently with appropriate guidance.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including PowerPoint and Excel.

- Experience working in a large corporate environment or on a strategy-focused team.

- Experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, business operations, finance, or a related strategic function.

- Foundational understanding of finance, business metrics, P&L concepts, or business case development.

- Experience developing executive-ready presentations, business updates, or strategic recommendations.

- Strong planning and execution skills, with the ability to demonstrate a strategic thought process.

- Ability to influence, collaborate, and build trusted relationships across teams.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Comfortable working through ambiguity and bringing structure to undefined or evolving priorities.

- Adaptable, coachable, and eager to learn and grow within the role.

- Experience in B2B technology, commercial strategy, operations, or an adjacent industry preferred.

jobs.description:

• Lead program planning and execution activities across multiple initiatives supporting MCICOM

• Provide schedule oversight to ensure alignment of project milestones, deliverables, and critical path activities
• Coordinate planning across engineering, logistics, financial, and operational teams
• Manage cross-program resource allocation to optimize personnel, funding, and materials
• Identify program risks and support development of mitigation strategies and risk management plans

• Conduct or support risk assessments and integrate findings into program planning
• Support resource planning and cross-functional coordination across all program elements
• Assist in development of Concepts of Operations (CONOPS) and future system requirements
• Provide input into long-term budgeting and outyear planning efforts
• Ensure effective stakeholder coordination across all supported installations

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Program Management, or a related field and Minimum of 15 years of experience in program or project management supporting federal or defense programs OR 10 years with a Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
• Demonstrated experience managing MILCON and/or ICG programs with end-to-end lifecycle ownership
• Extensive experience with scheduling, milestone tracking, and Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) oversight
• Strong background in risk management, resource allocation, and performance tracking
• Experience coordinating across engineering, logistics, financial, and operational teams
• Familiarity with Department of Defense processes and infrastructure program management
• Experience engaging with senior-level stakeholders in a federal or defense environment

• Strong leadership, organizational, and decision-making capabilities
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level briefings
• Active Secret clearance required
• Must be a U.S. Citizen
• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is a plus
• Master’s degree in Program Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or related field is a plus
• Experience supporting Marine Corps Installations Command (MCICOM) is a plus
• Strong familiarity with Installation Communication Grid (ICG) architecture and telecommunications infrastructure programs is a plus
• Experience supporting MILCON programs, including DD Form 1391 development and infrastructure modernization initiatives is a plus

• Experience developing program roadmaps, CONOPS, and long-term capability strategies is a plus

jobs.description:
The Services Brand Manager is the central liaison for the partner for working with CDW stakeholders across the organization, including sales, finance, and marketing. This position is responsible for driving revenue, profitability and awareness for their respective partner while engaging CDW partners across Partner and Product Management, Sales and Marketing. The Brand Manager interacts with senior level management regarding program development and pricing, while taking significant direction from a Category Manager.

What you’ll do

- Be the subject matter expert in a partner's product line and associated programs such as Bid Desk programs and Category Penetration

- Analyze industry information to identify opportunities and develop strategies to increase sales

- Develop go-to-market strategies that outline target customer segments, products, promotions, pricing, positioning, and complete launch plans

- Educate pre-sales and Product Specialists on new product introductions, transitions, competitive advantages, and opportunities to identify sales within their customer base

- Understand and communicate partner organizational structure with key decision makers and foster relationships with senior management

- Communicate partners’ financial conditions and market new products related to the assigned partner

- Engage daily with assigned partner to always maintain an open channel of communication to ensure that all CDW and partner stakeholders are kept up to date on all issues, initiatives, projects, meetings, or conferences

- Engage with CDW Procurement to help forecast sales volumes.

- Represent the assigned brand in meetings and speak to brand performance, category performance, program/promotion results, and current initiatives

- Provide comprehensive reporting both internally and externally on brand performance, category performance, industry trends, and market share

- Host Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to review partner performance and discuss joint initiatives

- Assist the Product Specialists in creation and review of content for respective manufacturer ads

- Obtain and facilitate necessary partner and industry certifications

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively interact with all stakeholders

jobs.title: Business Development Strategist - AIG
jobs.description:
The Lifecycle Services Business Development Stategist develops and executes strategic plans to support, position, and expand CDW DeviceCycle programs aligned to AIG product warranty offering. This role is responsible for driving growth across current programs while identifying and building new program opportunities that strengthen CDW’s device lifecycle value proposition. The individual partners closely with AIG, CDW sales, lifecycle services, and operational stakeholders to advance customer opportunities, enable seller awareness, support proposal and program development, and build executive-level relationships that accelerate adoption of DeviceCycle solutions.
What You will Do:
- Develop and execute business development strategies to support growth, adoption, and expansion of CDW DeviceCycle programs aligned to AIG across targeted customer segments and sales channels.
- Partner with CDW sales, Lifecycle Services, OEM, AIG, and operational teams to support current DeviceCycle programs, resolve program needs, and ensure consistent execution across customer opportunities.
- Identify, evaluate, and help build new DeviceCycle program opportunities that align customer lifecycle challenges with CDW repair, warranty, accidental damage protection, spare pool, and device continuity capabilities.
- Support sales teams in developing and managing DeviceCycle opportunity pipelines, including opportunity qualification, solution positioning, forecasting, and visibility into program performance and growth opportunities.
- Lead or support customer-facing discussions, presentations, RFP/RFI responses, and proposal development related to DeviceCycle programs, ensuring solutions are positioned clearly, competitively, and in alignment with customer requirements.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to define program requirements, pricing inputs, operational workflows, support models, and documentation needed to launch, scale, and sustain DeviceCycle offerings.
- Create and deliver field enablement, training, messaging, and best-practice resources that improve sales awareness, seller confidence, and customer adoption of DeviceCycle solutions.
- Monitor market, customer, and competitive trends to identify gaps, refine program positioning, and recommend enhancements that strengthen CDW’s lifecycle services value proposition.
- Provide AIG leadership and operations market trends and DeviceCycle client and prospect intelligence to proactively support product development and pricing.

What We Expect of You:
- Travel to our Chicago/Adams office location required. Hybrid, 3 days in-office schedule.
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
- 5 years of experience in technology market
- Strong understanding of device lifecycle services, including repair, warranty, accidental damage protection, spare device continuity, deployment, refresh, recovery, and disposition programs.
- Demonstrated ability to support, position, and grow DeviceCycle or related lifecycle services programs across sales channels, customer segments, and partner ecosystems.
- Experience identifying, evaluating, and developing new program opportunities that align customer device management challenges with scalable service, warranty, protection, and continuity solutions.
- Ability to collaborate effectively with sales, Lifecycle Services, OEM, AIG, operations, finance, legal, and other cross-functional stakeholders to define program requirements, resolve issues, and advance opportunities.
- Strong business development skills with experience building pipeline, qualifying opportunities, supporting forecasts, and translating program value into clear customer and seller messaging.
- Excellent presentation, written communication, and storytelling skills with the ability to explain DeviceCycle capabilities, AIG-aligned program value, and lifecycle services outcomes to executive, sales, operational, and customer audiences.
- Proven ability to coordinate complex, cross-functional initiatives from concept through launch, including program design, requirements gathering, pricing input, enablement, process alignment, and ongoing performance improvement.
- Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain accuracy, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing customer, partner, and business needs.
- Strong analytical, planning, and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate market trends, competitive positioning, program performance, and opportunities to expand CDW’s DeviceCycle portfolio.
- Ability to exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality when working with partner information, customer opportunities, pricing inputs, program strategy, and internal business plans.
- Self-directed, results-oriented, and able to take initiative, manage priorities, and execute responsibilities independently with minimal oversight.
- High energy and team-oriented candidate.
- Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% or as needed to other CDW locations or client sites
- Ability to understand, remember, and apply oral and/or written instructions or other information.
- Ability to excel in a high-touch, high-volume environment by effectively managing multiple priorities, staying organized, and consistently following through on commitments and obligations.
- Experience with device lifecycle services, warranty, accidental damage protection, repair, or related technology services programs, preferred.
- Proven success developing, launching, or growing technology services programs that support customer device management, protection, continuity, or lifecycle outcomes, preferred.
